name: button-output-checklist
description: Artifact-level validation checklist for generated New Zhanle ordinary button components.

checks.question: Is the control an ordinary button rather than a trading buy/sell action?
checks.evidenceRequired: Component classification showing trading buy/sell actions are routed to components-trading-actions instead of ordinary button rules.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved ordinary button route, type, size, structure, state, layout, and token rules from references/components-button.md and references/buttons/.

checks.question: Does every button declare one approved type, size, and structure?
checks.evidenceRequired: Evidence naming the button type, size, and structure from references/buttons and assets/tokens/button-tokens.json.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved ordinary button route, type, size, structure, state, layout, and token rules from references/components-button.md and references/buttons/.

checks.question: Are button colors, dimensions, radius, padding, and typography sourced from approved button tokens?
checks.evidenceRequired: Token usage list referencing assets/tokens/button-tokens.json and canonical color tokens where applicable.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved ordinary button route, type, size, structure, state, layout, and token rules from references/components-button.md and references/buttons/.

checks.question: Are default, pressed, and disabled states implemented according to the button rules?
checks.evidenceRequired: State evidence for default, pressed, and disabled; disabled uses the approved opacity behavior.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved ordinary button route, type, size, structure, state, layout, and token rules from references/components-button.md and references/buttons/.

checks.question: When a button contains icons, does it use an approved icon structure and rendered icon size/spacing?
checks.evidenceRequired: Rendered or component-structure evidence for leading, trailing, badge-icon, or icon-only structure.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved ordinary button route, type, size, structure, state, layout, and token rules from references/components-button.md and references/buttons/.

checks.question: Does the button width/layout follow the approved layout rule for its context?
checks.evidenceRequired: Layout evidence for content-width, full-width, paired-button, bottom action, or icon-only use.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved ordinary button route, type, size, structure, state, layout, and token rules from references/components-button.md and references/buttons/.

checks.question: Is the control kept in the button family only when it performs an action rather than representing persistent state?
checks.evidenceRequired: Behavior evidence: action controls use button rules; state toggles, selections, segmented controls, checkbox/radio, and icon toggles route to switch-family rules.
checks.fixIfFail: Re-route persistent state controls to components-switch instead of styling them as ordinary buttons.

checks.question: Do icon-only buttons use the approved icon-only size, icon metric, and hit area?
checks.evidenceRequired: Rendered or component evidence for icon-only button size, icon size, padding, and hit area from button tokens and references/buttons/icons.md.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved icon-only button token bundle instead of sizing only the SVG or using ad hoc padding.

checks.question: When buttons are paired or grouped, does spacing and width follow the approved button layout rules?
checks.evidenceRequired: Layout evidence for paired/full-width/content-width button rules from references/buttons/layout.md.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the approved paired or full-width layout instead of approximate gaps or unequal widths.

checks.question: Do used button tokens resolve correctly in light and dark modes?
checks.evidenceRequired: Light/dark token comparison for all colors used by the button.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved ordinary button route, type, size, structure, state, layout, and token rules from references/components-button.md and references/buttons/.
